title: Maxiyr's Cobblemon Mische
description: Cobblemon experience for Minecraft 1.21.1 with legendary Pokémon and enhanced world structures.
body:
# Maxiyr’s Cobblemon Mische – 1.21.1 Edition

**This modpack brings the classic Cobblemon experience to Minecraft 1.21.1 – expanded with legendary Pokémon and additional structures for a more lively world.**

Explore a dynamic open world, catch Pokémon, build your team, and discover new locations that make your adventure more varied.

## Features of the modpack:

- the Original Cobblemon Modpack for 1.21.1
- Legendary Pokémon included 
- Additional world structures for more exploration
- Optimized for multiplayer servers (e.g., Aternos)
- Fabric-based for stable performance
  
## This modpack is aimed at players who:

- love Cobblemon
- want to play on the latest Minecraft version
- want to play together with friends on servers

Perfect for survival worlds, co-op servers, and long-term adventures.

Perfekt für Survival-Welten, Coop-Server und langfristige Abenteuer.
